subject: Order form: cashflow evidence request and net-terms waiver
messages:
From: Maya Rodriguez <maya.rodriguez@novamed.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: finance@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form: invoice flow and net terms waiver request

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the draft order form — we reviewed it with Finance. Two items block our procurement approval: a) NovaMed needs an invoice path that splits the upfront credit and the monthly consumption invoices to different AP contacts (they require separate POs); and b) given our supplier approval timeline, we need a temporary waiver on Net 60 so the activation invoice can be Net 90 while we finish an internal payment holdback review.

Finance asked for:
- A short note from Redwood on how invoices will be routed (entity, remit-to, and PO mapping)
- Confirmation of the activation invoice amount and whether that can be invoiced separately to a different remit entity
- A copy of your SOC-2 summary and a PDF of any tax residency certificate you can provide for the order form (they call it "cashflow evidence")

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the temporary Net 90 activation invoice for this one-time go-live and provide the invoice-routing language Finance needs? We can sign once we have that and the DocuSign link back.

Appreciate it —
Maya
Maya Rodriguez
Head of Procurement, NovaMed
maya.rodriguez@novamed.com

---
Attachment: tax_certificate_request_template.docx (docx)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rodriguez <maya.rodriguez@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice flow and net terms waiver request

Maya — thanks for the clear list. We can take the following approach to avoid delaying signature:

1) Invoice routing and PO mapping: we will add an appendix to the Order Form that specifies two invoice streams — an "Activation Invoice" (one-time, for onboarding credits) invoiced to the parent AP remit (Entity A) and a "Consumption Invoice" (monthly) invoiced to the operating entity (Entity B). The appendix will list remit-to addresses and the PO field we will populate for each invoice. I'll attach the redline of the order form with that appendix included.

2) Net terms waiver: Redwood can accept Net 90 for the one activation invoice only, provided NovaMed signs the waiver appendix and we add a 30-day payment confirmation checkpoint post-activation (internal control on our side). This is a temporary concession limited to this inaugural invoice and will not affect the standard Net 30 on consumption invoices.

3) Cashflow evidence / tax docs: attaching our SOC 2 summary and asking NovaMed to send the completed tax certificate to accounting@redwood.com. If you prefer, we can accept the tax_certificate_novamed.pdf you referenced and attach it to the order file.

Next steps I propose:
- I will send a redline (orderform_v2_redlines.pdf) with the invoice appendix and the waiver language by EOD.
- Kim, can Legal confirm the waiver language below is acceptable and whether we should include any penalty/interest clause for the Net 90?
- Ben/Karthik: can you confirm billing ops can handle split remit and dual PO mapping?

Thanks — trying to keep this tight so we can get DocuSign out today.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

---
Attachment: SOC2_summary_redwood.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: orderform_v2_redlines.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Rodriguez <maya.rodriguez@novamed.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice flow and net terms waiver request

On Thu, Jun 26, 2025 at 11:03 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Maya — thanks for the clear list. We can take the following approach to avoid delaying signature:

Thanks, Rishi. I reviewed the proposed approach and the waiver draft in the attached redline. A few legal items to note:

- Scope & duration: the waiver must be explicitly time-limited in the appendix to "Activation Invoice only" and include an expiry date that equals the activation invoice due date + 60 days to cover any accounting reversals.
- Interest / late fee: for a temporary Net 90 we should include a modest late fee (1.5% monthly) after a 10-day grace period following the due date. This is standard for exceptions and helps protect Redwood cashflow without scaring the customer.
- Tax residency: if NovaMed provides a tax residency certificate for the billed entity we will mark consumption invoices as VAT-exempt where applicable; absent that, consumption invoices will include VAT and NovaMed will be responsible for reclaim.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

---
Attachment: orderform_v2_redlines_legal_notes.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice flow and net terms waiver request

Maya / team — quick ops confirmation:

- Billing can support two remit entities with separate PO fields. Activation invoice will be generated as a one-time upfront invoice and routed to Entity A remit-to and PO. Consumption invoices will be monthly, routed to Entity B.
- We will tag the activation invoice with the waiver flag so collections knows the due-date behavior is Net 90 and the late-fee rule applies (1.5% monthly after 10 days).
- Please send the tax_certificate_novamed.pdf to accounting@redwood.com and we'll attach it to the account profile prior to first consumption invoice.

If NovaMed can confirm the remit-to details and sign the waiver appendix by EOD Monday, we will push the DocuSign envelope and target activation in the week of July 7.

Action items:
- NovaMed: remit-to addresses for Entity A and Entity B + tax cert (Maya)
- Rishi: finalize orderform_v2_redlines with Kim's interest clause and send DocuSign link
- Ben/Karthik: prepare billing mapping and test with a dummy activation invoice once DocuSign is in flight

Thanks —
Ben Carter
